name: Mask of Terror (The Blushing Mermaid)
backstory: Mask of Terror is a human member of Auntie Ethel's flock. He can be found in the The Blushing Mermaid alongside Mask of Vengeance, Mask of Servitude, and the real Captain Grisly.
